en.headline: Symphony of Lights to end after 22 years with final show on 18 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the last performance will include a fireworks element on the evening the WinterFest begins, with other light projects to follow next year.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said A Symphony of Lights will stage its final performance on the evening of 18 November, bringing to a close a 22-year run of the nightly light and music show along Victoria Harbour.

Chairman Peter Lam said at a media briefing on the Hong Kong WinterFest that the last show will include a fireworks element to mark the occasion. The WinterFest itself will open the same evening. Other light-related projects are expected to be introduced next year.

The show has run since 2004, synchronising lights and lasers on more than 40 buildings on both sides of the harbour. The government earlier indicated it planned a proper farewell in the fourth quarter of 2026 and that a new light programme would replace the fixed nightly display.

Lam also outlined this year’s WinterFest, which will expand the Winter Village concept beyond Central to Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, and said the year-end countdown fireworks will carry a theme marking the 30th anniversary of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江22年歷史將於11月18日作最後一場演出
zh.dek: 旅發局主席林建岳表示，最後一場會加插煙火元素，當晚亦是繽紛冬日巡禮揭幕日，其他光影項目明年推出。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，「幻彩詠香江」將於11月18日晚上舉行最後一場表演，結束長達22年的維港燈光音樂匯演。
旅發局主席林建岳在「香港繽紛冬日巡禮」記者會上說，最後一場會特別加設煙火元素，以紀念這個時刻。冬日巡禮亦於同日晚上揭幕。其他光影項目預計明年陸續推出。
這項匯演自2004年起每晚上演，維港兩岸逾40幢大廈的燈光與音樂配合。政府早前已表明計劃在今年第四季為這項節目妥善告別，並以新的光影安排取代固定的每晚演出。
林建岳又介紹今年冬日巡禮，指出「冬日小鎮」將由中環擴展至尖沙咀及銅鑼灣，各有不同主題。年尾除夕倒數煙花匯演將以慶祝香港特區成立30周年為主題。
